service.description: Receive a customer return shipment's lines: for each return item the quantity that arrived, accepted and rejected (quarantined) alike, received as stock (AssetReceipt) on the item's shipment source, added to ReturnItem.receivedQuantity. It never changes returnQuantity and processes no response, so a second box, or units rejected at the dock, can still be received and credited against the authorization by settle#Return. An item reaches ReturnReceived (ReturnManResp for a manual response) when its received quantity equals the authorized quantity, the return when every item is handled, and the shipment ShipDelivered when every source is handled. Refuses more than was authorized (RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_RETURN), an item not on the shipment, a closed item, a shipment that is not a customer return, and an organization that does not settle returns separately (RETURN_SETTLEMENT_OFF: Mantle receives its returns when the shipment is delivered). Needs STOCK_RECEIVE in the receiving organization.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Defaults to the shipment's destination facility.

parameter.name: itemList
parameter.description: Maps of returnId, returnItemSeqId, quantityAccepted, quantityRejected, rejectionReasonEnumId and, for the stock, statusId (default AstOnHold) and lotNumber.

parameter.name: receivedItems
parameter.description: Each item's returnId, returnItemSeqId, receivedQuantity, statusId and assetReceiptIds.

service.description: Move an asset, or part of it, to a location or a container of its own facility (Move, HandheldMove, Relocate's rows), through mantle.product.AssetServices.move#Asset: a part becomes its own asset there, the whole asset moves, and the reservations it carries move with it as Mantle moves them. A retry with the same operation key and request answers the first move (alreadyApplied); a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an asset outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), equipment (NOT_STOCK), nothing on hand (NO_STOCK), a quantity above on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); another facility (OTHER_FACILITY: a transfer); a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE); the place it is already (SAME_LOCATION); a quarantined asset to a location whose type would release it (HELD_STOCK, F8). Reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again, so the order is re-reserved on available stock (F38). Expired and near-expiry stock moves with a warning naming its date. workEffortId is the production run a staging move is for (Manufacturing's Stage), kept in the answer.

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: The client's operation id (a scan id or a form's operation id), at most 200 characters; scoped by user and operation type.

parameter.name: toContainerId
parameter.description: A container of the facility: the asset moves into it, at its location.

parameter.name: toFacilityId
parameter.description: Given only to refuse another facility.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode MOVED, assetId, toAssetId, productId, quantity, facilityId, fromLocationSeqId, toLocationSeqId, toContainerId, fromStatusId, statusId, reservationsChecked, warnings (code, expiryDate, message), reason, workEffortId, and the operation fields.

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.product.asset.Asset', toAssetId, {resultCode: 'MOVED', assetId: assetId, toAssetId: toAssetId, productId: asset.productId, quantity: String(moveQuantity), facilityId: asset.facilityId, fromLocationSeqId: asset.locationSeqId || null, toLocationSeqId: target.locationSeqId, toContainerId: target.containerId, fromStatusId: asset.statusId, statusId: statusAfter, reservationsChecked: reservationsChecked, warnings: warnings, reason: reason || null, workEffortId: workEffortId || null})

service.description: Move each of the selected whole assets to one location or container (Relocate on Assets and Availability): each asset is its own move#Stock, in its own transaction, under the operation "operationKey/assetId", so an asset that cannot move is named with its reason and the others move; a retry of the batch answers the assets already moved. Refuses the whole batch only without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED) or with no asset.

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Per asset: key (the assetId), ok, resultCode and result (move#Stock's answer), or reasonCode and message.

return.message: ASSETS_REQUIRED: Choose the assets to move

set.from: posting.batch(context, rows, id => id, 'mantle.shipment.WarehouseTaskServices.move#Stock', id => ({assetId: id, toLocationSeqId: toLocationSeqId, toContainerId: toContainerId, toFacilityId: toFacilityId, reason: reason}))

service.description: Put an asset, or part of it, into a container where both are (ContainerDetail's AddOrRemoveAsset): through move#Asset at the container's own location, so nothing moves. Refuses an asset away from the container (ASSET_AWAY_FROM_CONTAINER: move it there, F9), one in another container (IN_OTHER_CONTAINER) or already in this one (ALREADY_IN_CONTAINER), a container holding another owner's stock (CONTAINER_OWNER), and a status the location would change (STATUS_CHANGE); and as move#Stock: STOCK_MOVE, the user's facilities, the stock, the quantity, an open location. A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode ATTACHED, assetId, toAssetId, containerId, quantity, facilityId, locationSeqId.

return.message: ALREADY_IN_CONTAINER: Asset ${assetId} is already in container ${containerId}
IN_OTHER_CONTAINER: Asset ${assetId} is in container ${asset.containerId}; remove it first

set.from: 'Asset ' + assetId + ' is at ' + (asset.locationSeqId || 'no location') + ', container ' + containerId + ' at ' + (box.locationSeqId || 'no location') + '; move it there first'

return.message: CONTAINER_OWNER: Container ${containerId} holds another owner's stock
STATUS_CHANGE: Asset ${assetId} would change status; move it instead

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.product.asset.Asset', toAssetId, {resultCode: 'ATTACHED', assetId: assetId, toAssetId: toAssetId, containerId: containerId, quantity: String(moveQuantity), facilityId: asset.facilityId, locationSeqId: box.locationSeqId})

service.description: Take an asset, or part of it, out of its container where it is (ContainerDetail's AddOrRemoveAsset): through move#Asset at the same location with no container, so nothing moves. Refuses an asset in no container (NOT_IN_CONTAINER) and a status the location would change (STATUS_CHANGE); and as move#Stock: STOCK_MOVE, the user's facilities, the stock, the quantity, an open location. A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode DETACHED, assetId, toAssetId, containerId, quantity, facilityId, locationSeqId.

return.message: NOT_IN_CONTAINER: Asset ${assetId} is in no container
STATUS_CHANGE: Asset ${assetId} would change status; move it instead

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.product.asset.Asset', toAssetId, {resultCode: 'DETACHED', assetId: assetId, toAssetId: toAssetId, containerId: asset.containerId, quantity: String(moveQuantity), facilityId: asset.facilityId, locationSeqId: asset.locationSeqId})

service.description: Move a container with all its contents to another location of its facility (ContainerDetail's MoveContainer), all or nothing: every content asset is checked first (a quarantined one the new location would release refuses the whole move, HELD_STOCK, naming it), then the container's location changes and each asset moves with it through move#Asset, which gives it the location type's status; reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again (F38). Refuses as move#Stock: STOCK_MOVE, the user's facilities, another facility (OTHER_FACILITY), a closed location, the place it is (SAME_LOCATION). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode MOVED, containerId, facilityId, fromLocationSeqId, toLocationSeqId, assets (assetId, productId, quantity, fromStatusId, statusId), warnings, reason.

set.from: Array.from(contents).map(asset => ({assetId: asset.assetId, productId: asset.productId, quantity: String(asset.quantityOnHandTotal ?? 0), assetPoolId: asset.assetPoolId, fromStatusId: asset.statusId, statusId: posting.keepHeld(asset, target)}))

posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.product.asset.Container', containerId, {resultCode: 'MOVED', containerId: containerId, facilityId: box.facilityId, fromLocationSeqId: box.locationSeqId || null, toLocationSeqId: target.locationSeqId, assets: lines.map(line => ({assetId: line.assetId, productId: line.productId, quantity: line.quantity, fromStatusId: line.fromStatusId, statusId: line.statusId})), warnings: warnings, reason: reason || null})

service.description: Repair the reservations at a facility that the preview (WarehousePolicyServices.preview#FacilityReservations) named, as previewed: refuses when they changed since (PREVIEW_CHANGED: preview again). A reservation on stock no longer available, for another facility's order or on a pool the order does not qualify for is checked again (check#AssetReservationValid: removed and re-reserved); a not-available reservation of a product with available stock there is moved onto it (reserve#IncreasedAsset on that stock). Each in its own transaction: one that fails is named and the others go on. Requires STOCK_POLICY_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a facility of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode REPAIRED, facilityId, productId, rows (per reservation: assetReservationId, orderId, orderItemSeqId, reasonCode, ok, message), repairedCount, failedCount.

return.message: PREVIEW_CHANGED: The reservations changed since the check; check them again

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, home.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.facility.Facility', facilityId, {resultCode: 'REPAIRED', facilityId: facilityId, productId: productId || null, rows: rows, repairedCount: rows.filter(row => row.ok).length, failedCount: rows.filter(row => !row.ok).length})
